message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: person performed welding in a greenhouse (dacha) without professional skill, causing fire that destroyed 32 greenhouses and crops, loss 682,260 RMB. Family compensated and got victim's forgiveness. The act is negligent causing fire, leading to property damage. Likely crime: "过失致人死亡" is not death, just property. So "过失放火" or "放火罪" (arson). Under Chinese criminal law, Article 114: "放火罪" includes intentional or reckless (negligent) fire causing property loss. The description: "在无专业电焊技能的情况下...焊大门...火星引燃...火势蔓延...导致...烧毁". This is reckless (negligent) fire. So crime: "放火" (arson). Could also be "过失放火" but classification is still "放火罪". In examples, they used "放火" for arson. So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>.
